name: ito_shared_summary_v1

filter.design: scipy.signal.butter at fs = 25 Hz (bilinear, pre-warped: -3 dB at the cutoff)
filter.initial_state: steady state at the first sample of each block
filter.approximation: The exact MPU6886 DLPF response is not known. This filter only matches its documented 3 dB bandwidth (5.1 Hz for A_DLPF_CFG=6 [to verify] against the datasheet). Order 1 is chosen because the documented noise bandwidth / 3 dB ratio (7.8 / 5.1 = 1.53) is close to a first-order filter (pi/2 = 1.57), not a 2nd-order Butterworth (1.11). The chip filters a ~1 kHz signal; content above the dataset's Nyquist frequency cannot be reproduced. Raw samples are treated as evenly spaced.

point_sampling.rule: nearest raw sample to each 100 ms tick (value and native label); no averaging
point_sampling.missed_tick: ends the block (the firmware drops a window with a sample > 20 ms late)

time: relative only: t_rel_ms = ms since the first 10 Hz sample of each animal-day; day = the loader's local day (Asia/Tokyo); epoch t_ms is dropped after conversion

harmonise.rounding: nearest multiple of step_g, ties to even (numpy rint); the collar's exact rounding is [to verify]

harmonise_gravity: gravity_resting.csv has both quantise=True and quantise=False

windows.segment: consecutive samples of one animal-day with the same base class; a change of class, an unused sample, or a time step > 1000 ms starts a new segment
windows.window: fixed, non-overlapping, from the segment start, fully inside the segment
windows.strict: subset of valid windows with all 150 slots filled

device_blocks: device_lp_point blocks are not segments here; device_block_boundaries.csv counts missed ticks (filter continues) and filter restarts (raw gap > 300 ms) separately

notes: the ReadMe's BLN appears as an empty string in the data
ReadMe URI count for cow1 is 239; the data have 238 (URI total 621 matches)

outputs: aggregated counts and means only; no per-sample rows, no per-window features
